name: notification-flood-lockscreen
title: Notification Flood Lock Screen
description: A phone lock screen fills with a stack of escalating message notifications, then a last one answers the flood.
useWhen: A problem should pile up visually as a stack of incoming messages before the product answers it.
The ad is a vertical social video.
avoidWhen: You need a calm single notification: use a notification block.
The messages must carry real app branding.
author: HeyGen (Hyperframes)

variables.label: Incoming messages
variables.description: Up to 11 notifications, one per line, written as sender | message.
variables.default:
Sarah Chen | Hey! Any chance you could get the launch video done by Friday?

variables.label: Payoff sender
variables.description: Sender of the last notification, the answer to the flood (the name of whoever the video promotes).

variables.label: Clock times
variables.description: Four clock readings, comma separated; the clock changes three times during the flood.
